import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify highly correlated features (|r| >= 0.6)
    corr_threshold = 0.6
    n_features = len(feats.ids)
    
    # Compute correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    
    # Find pairs with |r| >= 0.6
    high_corr_pairs = []
    for i in range(n_features):
        for j in range(i+1, n_features):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i, j]) >= corr_threshold:
                high_corr_pairs.append((feats.ids[i], feats.ids[j]))
    
    # If no strong correlations, return empty design
    if not high_corr_pairs:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster features based on correlation
    clustering = SpectralClustering(n_clusters=1, affinity='precomputed', random_state=0)
    similarity = 1 - np.abs(corr_matrix)
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(similarity)
    
    # Get cluster 0 features (the main module)
    module_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(feats.ids)) if clusters[i] == 0]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (keep one representative)
    unique_module = []
    for fid in module_features:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        feature_vec = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        
        # Check if this vector is similar to any already selected
        is_similar = False
        for existing_fid in unique_module:
            existing_col = feats.column(existing_fid)
            existing_vec = feats.x[:, existing_col]
            corr = np.corrcoef(feature_vec, existing_vec)[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) > 0.95:
                is_similar = True
                break
        
        if not is_similar:
            unique_module.append(fid)
    
    # Select top features by effect size
    effect_sizes = []
    for fid in unique_module:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        y1_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 1, col_idx])
        y0_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 0, col_idx])
        effect_sizes.append(abs(y1_mean - y0_mean))
    
    # Sort by effect size and take top 4 (max 4 due to constraint)
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1][:4]
    drivers = tuple(unique_module[i] for i in sorted_indices if i < len(unique_module))
    
    # Create loadings dictionary (weighted sum of all module features)
    loadings = {}
    for fid in unique_module:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        y1_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 1, col_idx])
        y0_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 0, col_idx])
        loadings[fid] = y1_mean - y0_mean
    
    # Keep design small - only include essential elements
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=drivers,  # Only include drivers in columns
        products=(),
        loadings={fid: loadings[fid] for fid in drivers}
    )
